# GenServer Proxy v0.1.72 - Table of Contents

> Invokes call, cast or stop with a GenServer registered via a server ID.
Will wait a bit if the GenServer is not yet registered on restarts.

## Modules

- [GenServer.Proxy](https://gen-server-proxy.hexdocs.pm/GenServer.Proxy.md): Invokes the following functions with a GenServer registered via a server ID
- [GenServer.Proxy.Caller](https://gen-server-proxy.hexdocs.pm/GenServer.Proxy.Caller.md)
- [GenServer.Proxy.Caster](https://gen-server-proxy.hexdocs.pm/GenServer.Proxy.Caster.md)
- [GenServer.Proxy.Log](https://gen-server-proxy.hexdocs.pm/GenServer.Proxy.Log.md)
- [GenServer.Proxy.Stopper](https://gen-server-proxy.hexdocs.pm/GenServer.Proxy.Stopper.md)
- [GenServer.Proxy.Timer](https://gen-server-proxy.hexdocs.pm/GenServer.Proxy.Timer.md)
